In UTC, 09:30 ET (America/New_York) on 2 Nov 2026. Need to convert to UTC. In November, US is in EST (UTC-5) maybe? Actually daylight saving ends early November. In 2026, DST ends on November 2? Typically DST ends first Sunday in November, which in 2026 is November 2. At 09:30 America/New_York time, need to determine if it's before or after the shift. If the event is at 09:30 on 2 Nov, DST might have ended at 2:00 am, so after that it's UTC-5? Actually after DST ends, standard time is UTC-5. So 09:30 EST = 14:30 UTC. Wait: EST is UTC-5, so 09:30 EST = 14:30 UTC. That matches the requirement also 14:30 Europe/London. In London, on 2 Nov 2026, after DST ends? UK DST ends last Sunday of October, which in 2026 is October 25. So by Nov 2, London is on GMT (UTC+0). So 14:30 London time = 14:30 UTC. So the event is at 14:30 UTC on 2 Nov 2026, lasting 30 minutes, ending at 15:00 UTC.

Thus we need to create event on cal-alice with start 2026-11-02T09:30:00-05:00? Actually we must specify timeZone UTC with Z suffix per instruction: "Submit event writes in UTC with a Z suffix and timeZone UTC; convert named local times before writing." So we need to convert 09:30 America/New_York to UTC: 14:30 UTC. So start time in UTC: 2026-11-02T14:30:00Z, end at 15:00 UTC.
